notes.title: Updated Demo Version
notes.content: [p]The demo version of the game has been updated with several features that were previously only available in the final release.[/p][p][/p][p]This update adds multiple features that were originally introduced in the final version or in post-launch updates of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]These updates include changes to the game’s interface, difficulty balancing, Spanish language support, adjustments to some maps, and improved keyboard navigation in certain main menus.[/p][p][/p][p]With this update, players can now get a true sense of what the full game is like—something that wasn’t possible before with the outdated demo version.[/p]

notes.title: EPIC UPDATE: NEW LANGUAGE AND QUEST ENHANCEMENTS!
notes.content: [p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/wNHCjfMX/Captura-de-tela-2025-07-29-110843.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This massive update introduces a new language to the realm - Spanish - to welcome even more brave souls to our medieval adventure. Furthermore, we've enriched the kingdom with new events and enhanced maps. We've also vanquished several minor bugs discovered during our questing trials.[/p][p][/p][p]The Spanish language has been conjured into the game, empowering players from Spanish-speaking realms to embark on their journey with greater ease, thus expanding our fellowship across more territories. [/p][p][/p][p]This linguistic enchantment includes written dialogues, interface elements, voice acting (opening and ending cinematics), and in-game notifications. Soon, more tongues from distant lands shall be added to our arcane codex.[/p][p][/p][p]We have also summoned new events, dialogues, and legendary items to various regions of the map, while performing minor enchantments upon existing ones.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we've dispelled several minor curses within the game as they were discovered during our trials or reported by fellow adventurers from the realm.[/p][p][/p][p]May this update bring joy to your questing! We shall meet again in Sephadel! Until next time, brave adventurers![/p]

notes.title: New features added in version 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, dear adventurers! Are you ready to embark on this epic journey in a completely revamped way?? Then check out what's new in the 1.1 update:[/h3]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/CKhYWqX1/Devlog.png[/img]

[h3]- Added a dynamic minimap[/h3]  
Players will now have a minimap of the current area displayed on the game screen, showing their location as well as all important events on the map, such as enemies, chests, items, new quests, doors, etc.

[h3]- Speeding up vegetable harvesting when sleeping[/h3]  
From now on, every time the player sleeps in their house at the Fortress, all crops will advance in their growth, bringing them closer to harvest.

[h3]- Changes to the game HUD[/h3]  
Due to the addition of the minimap, several elements of the game's main HUD have been redesigned or repositioned on the screen to prevent conflicts or overlapping elements.

[h3]- Minor bug fixes[/h3]  
During the update process and game improvements, some minor errors were found and properly fixed.

We hope you enjoy this update! We appreciate the players' feedback, and we'll see you in the next updates.

Best regards,  

[b]DreamStories[/b]

notes.title: Enjoy Envyus on RPG Maker Festival 2025
notes.content:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/QMqNVSB/gif-jogo-exp2.gif[/img][/center]

[h3]Are you ready to enjoy the RPG Maker Festival 2025 with this great game?[/h3]

During the festival period, you will have an exclusive discount, so you can enjoy the game at a super affordable price.

In addition, you will be able to watch a live broadcast, which will give you an idea of ​​the features, gameplay, mechanics and a bit of the game's history, so you can learn even more about the game before playing it.

Several small updates and bug fixes will also be made available during the festival, making the game even more complete and attractive to everyone.

The event will take place from February 3rd to February 10th, 2025. We hope you enjoy the news.

Big hug.

Dream Stories Team.

notes.title: New Achievements Added
notes.content:
The achievement system has been added to the game, allowing players to unlock various achievements throughout their adventure.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PZ2W8kZ/Captura-de-tela-2024-11-14-084437.png[/img]

These achievements can be obtained in multiple ways, such as defeating enemies, completing events, completing missions, or exploring the game's maps, for example.

This is your chance to explore all of Envyus' content and achieve 100% completion.

So, are you ready for this challenge?

notes.title: Envyus Gameplay Live Stream
notes.content:
[b]Join us on October 14, 2024, for an exclusive live stream of the highly anticipated game Envyus at the Steam Next Fest![/b]

This live event will dive deep into the heart of the game, offering a detailed look at its core mechanics, storyline, and overall gameplay experience. Whether you're a fan of immersive narratives or innovative gameplay systems, Envyus promises to deliver both.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/0yFMG11/2024-09-30-T20-42-12-765-Z.png[/img]

During the live stream, we'll explore the unique mechanics that make Envyus stand out, from its combat system to its world-building elements. You'll get an in-depth understanding of how these systems work together to create a rich and engaging experience. We’ll also dive into the storyline, giving you a sneak peek at the plot twists and character arcs that make Envyus a game to watch.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ns4Msjp/2024-10-07-T02-32-46-519-Z.png[/img]

In addition to the gameplay breakdown, we’ll share exciting updates about the expected release date and other key information you won’t want to miss. Whether you’re a casual player or a die-hard fan of the genre, this live stream is your chance to learn everything you need to know about Envyus. Make sure to tune in and be part of the journey!

[b]We'll be waiting for you![/b]

notes.title: Demo version is now avaliable
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Dm5HJaH-PC8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are pleased to inform you that the demo version of the game is now available for download.

You can play some side missions and one main mission. Since the world is open, the demo might end in ten minutes, but it can also last forty minutes, depending on the player's curiosity for exploration.

The game is being improved and receiving new features, and certainly, the final version will be more refined and have more features than this demo version.

We appreciate the players' willingness to download this version and it would be very helpful if you could leave a review of this version, which would greatly assist in making the final release even better.

Thank you to all the players.

DreamStories Team.
